{{Short description|Belgian mathematician (1862–1945)}}
'''Joseph Gustave Jacques Deruyts''' (18 March 1862{{snd}}5 July 1945)<ref name=BESTORref>[https://www.bestor.be/wiki/index.php/Deruyts,_Joseph_Gustave_Jacques_(1862-1945) Deruyts, Joseph Gustave Jacques, bestor.be]</ref> was a Belgian [[mathematician]], known as a pioneer of [[group representation theory]]. He is the elder brother of the mathematician {{interlanguage link|François Deruyts|fr}}.

Deruyts received his doctorate in 1883 from the [[University of Liège]] and was appointed there as assistant to Louis Pérard in [[experimental physics]]. Deruyts joined the academic staff in mathematics and was appointed in 1883 a professor of geometry at the University of Liège, where he remained until retirement as professor emeritus. 

He was elected in 1892 as a member of the [[Royal Academy of Science, Letters and Fine Arts of Belgium]], which has been awarding since 1952 the [[Jacques Deruyts Prize]].

He published in 1892 a treatise ''Essai d'une théorie générale des formes algébriques''<ref>{{cite book|author=Deruyts, Jacques|title=Essai d'une théorie générale des formes algébriques|location=Paris|year=1891|url=https://hdl.handle.net/2027/coo.31924059551337}}</ref> which was pioneering research in the representation theory of [[Linear group|linear groups]] and [[Algebraic group|algebraic groups]].<ref>{{cite book|author=Curtis, Charles W.|title=Pioneers of Representation Theory: Frobenius, Burnside, Schur, and Brauer|publisher=American Mathematical Soc.|year=1999|pages=[https://archive.org/details/pioneersofrepres0015curt/page/177 177]–178|isbn=0-8218-9002-6|url=https://archive.org/details/pioneersofrepres0015curt|url-access=registration}}</ref> He was an Invited Speaker of the [[International Congress of Mathematicians|ICM]] with talk "Sur la théorie algébrique des formes à séries de ''n''  variables" in 1920 at [[Strasbourg]].<ref>{{cite book|author=Deruyts, J.|chapter-url=http://www.mathunion.org/ICM/ICM1920/Main/icm1920.0258.0258.ocr.pdf|chapter=Sur la théorie algébrique des formes à séries de ''n'' variables|page=258|year=1921|title=''In:'' Compte rendu du Congrès international des mathématiciens tenu à Strasbourg du 22 au 30 Septembre 1920|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171029065752/http://www.mathunion.org/ICM/ICM1920/Main/icm1920.0258.0258.ocr.pdf|archive-date=October 29, 2017|url-status=dead}}</ref>
